entries.text: When no usable model is configured, the Assistant explains what setup is needed and offers a shortcut to model settings; local writing remains available.
OpenAI model discovery now includes GPT-6.1 models.
Choose Review or Direct edit mode with a switch in the Assistant composer instead of opening a menu.
Telemetry sharing is off by default. The desktop workspace invites you to enable it or dismiss the invitation, and you can change your choice in Settings.

Desktop backups no longer include saved API keys or environment-variable values. Restoring keeps this installation’s AI connections and model selections; if none are configured, it restores environment-variable references only.
Desktop update details now identify stable releases marked as security releases, even when the version has no security suffix.

securityReason: Desktop backups could expose saved API keys or environment-variable values; backups now exclude them, and restores preserve the destination’s AI settings.
